name: PapaMap
subtitle: Changing tables for dads
promotionalText: About 26,000 changing tables in 49 countries from OpenStreetMap, with changes in minutes. Green means dad can get to it.
description:
PapaMap shows changing tables that dads can actually get to.

Green means both parents can reach the table. Red means it is in the ladies' room only. Grey means nobody has recorded yet which room it is in.

The data comes from OpenStreetMap, about 26,000 changing tables in 49 countries, refreshed every night.

"Nearest changing table" shows the closest table you can reach, with the distance. "Route" opens your navigation app, Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze or Organic Maps.

On a grey pin the app asks "Which room is the changing table in?". Your answer goes straight to OpenStreetMap. You need an account there once, that takes a minute, after that it is a few seconds per pin. If the table is missing completely, add it with "Add a place".

Filters for accessible, play corner and high chair. Dad view and mum view. Search for places and addresses. Save a city offline and the map works without a connection. Siri, a widget and a Control Center control show the nearest table without opening the app.

"My PapaMap" lists your answers, saved places and how much of your city is answered already.

The app collects no data. Your location stays on the phone.

whatsNew:
New in 1.5:
• Places with a high chair now appear even without a changing table: purple rings with a high chair inside, with their own filter, "High chair only".
• "+ Add a place" now also takes a place with only a high chair or a play area, and its list includes bakeries, patisseries and indoor playgrounds.
• Public toilet pins no longer ask about a play area.
